hero.title: Nostr WoT App Support

channels.title: Get help

contact.title: Contact us
contact.description: Send us a message through the contact form, for questions about the app or the hosted wallet.

bug.title: Report a bug
bug.description: Open the bug report form on GitHub. Reports are public, so leave out anything private.

feature.title: Request a feature
feature.description: Suggest an improvement on GitHub. Requests are public too.

channels.inApp: In the app, Settings > Help > Report a bug opens the same form with the app version, iOS / Android version and device model already filled in.

include.title: What to include in a report
include.description: To help us reproduce a problem, include:

items.version: The app version and build, shown at the bottom of Settings, for example 1.0.0 (42)
items.language: The language the app is set to
items.steps: What you did, what you expected and what happened instead, with screenshots if they help

include.never: Never send your seed phrase, private key (nsec), password or PIN to us or to anyone else. We will never ask for them.

createAccount.question: Creating or recovering an identity
createAccount.answer: Create an identity with a passkey or recovery phrase, or import an existing identity. Recovery options include your saved phrase, a supported passkey recovery copy or an exported encrypted backup. A passkey backup restores the seed; do not assume it restores every setting or imported key. Choose your lock timer and PIN during setup.

backup.question: Keys, unlocking and recovery
backup.answer: Passkey recovery encrypts your seed phrase. New backups do not include account names, account lists or derivation paths; older backups may include them. Your credential provider can store the encrypted recovery copy. If you consent to relay storage, it can instead be published to Nostr relays. Recovery uses the provider and, when needed, configured recovery relays (currently nos.lol, relay.damus.io and nostr-01.yakihonne.com). Passkey availability and synchronization depend on your provider. Keep an independent recovery copy.

pairRemote.question: Network connections and recipients
pairRemote.answer: Remote signing (NIP-46), profiles, relay lists, published events, Archive synchronization and NWC use Nostr relays. Encrypted requests hide their content from relays, but relays can see public keys, IP addresses and connection times. Published events and profile information can be public. Paired devices can also exchange encrypted requests over the local network or Bluetooth where supported. Android supports NIP-55; compatible iPhone apps can use the signing action extension.

wallet.question: Optional hosted wallet and retention
wallet.answer: DANDELION LABS JOINT STOCK COMPANY holds the hosted wallet funds. The service stores your Nostr public key, wallet identifiers, balance, invoices, payment amounts, dates and status, claimed public Lightning address and NWC app connections with their limits. It processes network request data and operational logs to provide and secure the service. Wallet records remain while the wallet exists; we do not promise a fixed deletion period for operational logs or backups. The hosted service can move its funds, and access depends on its availability. Connecting another wallet does not by itself make that wallet self-custodial: custody depends on its operator.

network.question: Network connections and recipients
network.answer: LNbits receives requests at the server you configure; NWC sends encrypted requests through its configured relay to your wallet provider. Those operators process payment data under their own policies. Lightning address services receive invoice lookups. Image hosts receive image requests; Google’s favicon service receives connected-site domains and your IP address. Public GitHub support reports contain whatever you submit, including any prefilled app, OS and device details. The current mobile apps have no built-in Tor, embedded Breez/Spark wallet or post-quantum signing. The app has no advertising or analytics tracking; these service connections still process data. NIP-05 verification contacts the identifier’s domain. Fiat conversion rates are requested from Coinbase. LNURL and compatible NFC card operations contact the service encoded in the address or card. These services receive your IP address and request data. Privacy mode limits activity recording and third-party profile content; it does not make all network use anonymous.

forgotPassword.question: Deleting data and getting help
forgotPassword.answer: Local deletion does not remove passkeys, recovery copies held by credential providers, exported files or published relay data. Manage passkeys with your credential provider and delete exported copies where you saved them. Relays and recipients may retain copies even after a deletion request. We cannot guarantee erasure of those copies or recover your keys if all recovery methods are lost.

deleteData.title: Deleting your data
deleteData.description: Remove an account in Accounts or use Delete all data in Settings to erase local app data. Move hosted funds out first and select the separate hosted-wallet deletion option; local erasure alone does not delete the server wallet. The deletion flow reports server failures. A completed hosted deletion removes the wallet, payment history, Lightning address, app connections and account association. If you no longer have the app, use our contact form to request deletion. Never send a seed phrase, private key, PIN or wallet connection secret. Local deletion does not remove passkeys, recovery copies held by credential providers, exported files or published relay data. Manage passkeys with your credential provider and delete exported copies where you saved them. Relays and recipients may retain copies even after a deletion request. We cannot guarantee erasure of those copies or recover your keys if all recovery methods are lost.
